name: Otter.ai
description: Otter.ai records and transcribes meetings and conversations, with a free Basic plan and Pro, Business and Enterprise plans priced per user.
features: Meeting and recording minutes per user
API and webhooks listed as features
limitations: Basic has 300 minutes per month, 30 minutes per conversation and 3 lifetime file imports
Some listed offers are valid only with an India-issued credit card

plans.name: Pro
highlights: 1,200 meeting minutes per user per month
plans.note: Promotional figures ($8.49 monthly, $4.17 annual) are shown only for an India-issued card

free.details: 300 transcription minutes per user per month, 3 lifetime file imports, 30 minutes per conversation, last 25 conversations in history.

pricing.regional: Prices are in USD. Tax treatment: not stated.
notes: The Business plan lists both '6,000 imported-file minutes per user' and 'unlimited imports', which conflict on the page.

verification.notes: Product active. Annual view, USD: Pro $8.33 per user/month (save 51%), Business $19.99 per user/month (save 33%), Basic free with 300 monthly minutes, Enterprise by demo. Monthly figures ($16.99 and $30) are from an earlier check and were not re-seen.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

keyFeature: Records and transcribes meetings and conversations

profile.headline: Meeting transcripts, summaries and answers across your conversations

capabilities.title: Capture conversations from anywhere
capabilities.text: Record from a Mac or Windows desktop, from mobile, or from a browser.

capabilities.title: Read the transcript as people speak
capabilities.text: Live transcription with several languages and speaker recognition.

capabilities.title: Get the summary and next steps
capabilities.text: Instant summaries with decisions, action items and insights.

capabilities.title: Ask questions across your meetings
capabilities.text: Otter AI Chat searches your meetings and connected apps to answer questions and help create follow-ups and reports.

featureCards.name: Bot-free desktop app
featureCards.text: Record directly from your desktop without a bot joining the call.

featureCards.name: Pre-call briefings
featureCards.text: Briefing documents with earlier discussions and action items, delivered before a meeting.

featureCards.name: Live-Assist coaching
featureCards.text: Real-time prompts during calls based on conversation history and company playbooks.

featureCards.name: CRM sync
featureCards.text: Deal details, notes and next steps are extracted and synced to your CRM.

featureCards.name: Channels
featureCards.text: Group meetings by team, project or topic for shared access.

featureCards.name: MCP Server
featureCards.text: Lets ChatGPT, Claude and other AI chat tools securely use your meeting knowledge.

audienceDetail.text: Call notes, live coaching tips, automated follow-ups and CRM sync.
Capture lectures and study sessions as searchable notes and summaries.
Interview transcription and help organising thoughts into content.
Real-time help during interviews and structured candidate insights, with notes synced to Greenhouse.

scenarios.title: Capture a sales call
scenarios.text: Get call notes and push the deal details to your CRM.

scenarios.title: Record a lecture
scenarios.text: Keep searchable notes and a summary for studying.

scenarios.title: Transcribe an interview
scenarios.text: Turn a recorded conversation into text you can search and quote.

scenarios.title: Prepare for a meeting
scenarios.text: Read the briefing with earlier discussions and open action items first.

gettingStarted.text: Use the Start for free button to sign up.
The site lists Basic, Business and Enterprise; the Enterprise plan is by contacting sales.
Link your calendar and meeting tools, or install the desktop app, mobile apps or Chrome extension.
